description: Find videos from MyLatinLife's YouTube catalog, newest first, about residency, citizenship, banking, tax, cost of living and life in Latin America. Optionally filter by country or words in the title; this searches MLL's channel, not all YouTube.

country.description: Only videos about this country. Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

limit.description: How many videos to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Words the video title must contain, e.g. "retire" or "bank account".

name: find_videos
title: MyLatinLife videos
